trigger_condition: Demo kid must have a demo- prefix while every kid must equal its JWK thumbprint.
guard_snippet: Define and test one mode-aware kid rule, including an explicit demo exception.
potential_consequence: Demo key-format and environment tests require incompatible values.

trigger_condition: Wrong-then-correct and correct-then-wrong exchanges both require a familyless tombstone.
guard_snippet: Split sequences: initial failure leaves no family; initial success retains the family and subsequent replay revokes it.
potential_consequence: The criterion can erase the successful exchange replay-revocation association.

trigger_condition: HTTPS-only redirect registration conflicts with the required HTTP localhost demo RP.
guard_snippet: Choose a narrowly scoped demo loopback exception or an HTTPS demo topology and test registration.
potential_consequence: The specified demo cannot complete its authorization round-trip.

trigger_condition: Cookie expiry alternates between flow_ttl and flow_ttl plus 30 seconds.
guard_snippet: Define one absolute flow expiration and derive cookie expiry, cleanup and tests from it.
potential_consequence: The browser loses its binding while its server flow remains live.

trigger_condition: Backward wall-clock steps extend token acceptance beyond monotonic revocation retention.
guard_snippet: Define rollback handling or process-relative token deadlines; test a revoked token after deny-list expiry while wall time precedes exp.
potential_consequence: A revoked token can become usable again.

trigger_condition: Production must reject historical demo keys but cannot access their demo-volume fingerprint history.
guard_snippet: Provide accessible durable fingerprint history or explicitly narrow the guarantee to known supplied history and fixtures.
potential_consequence: The asserted imported-demo-key rejection cannot be established.

location: architecture.md ADR-009 Upstream HTTP and Upstream session
trigger_condition: Bounded HTTP transport rules omit upstream session initialization.
guard_snippet: Apply timeouts, response caps and no-redirect rules to initialization too; define failure transitions.
potential_consequence: Initialization can retain capacity indefinitely or bypass transport safeguards.

trigger_condition: The bounded notification target map has no full-map or entry-retention rule.
guard_snippet: Define capacity, normalization, retention and fail-closed admission; test target churn.
potential_consequence: Churn can reset push limits or block login without a recovery rule.

trigger_condition: The fifth flow expires a cookie without specifying server-flow resource handling.
guard_snippet: Specify cancellation and resource release, or deliberate retention to timeout; test the chosen behavior.
potential_consequence: Unreachable sessions and reservations continue consuming capacity.

trigger_condition: LoadAndDelete conflicts with retained consumed entries required by the replay design.
guard_snippet: Use one atomic consume operation preserving the family tombstone, or specify race-free separate-store publication.
potential_consequence: A concurrent replay can fail to find the issued token family.

trigger_condition: The shared cap equates pending concurrency with reservations, codes and long-lived tombstones.
guard_snippet: Size each population using its arrival rate and residence time, or document the intentional throughput limit.
potential_consequence: Successful login tombstones can reject new authorizations despite idle upstream capacity.

trigger_condition: The doctor story still permits optional readyz integration.
guard_snippet: Supersede optional readyz integration; keep upstream diagnostics in the opt-in doctor command.
potential_consequence: Deferred implementation can restore the readiness behavior the architecture retired.

location: architecture.md ADR-008 Access token, ADR-009 Clock; epics.md Story 2.6
trigger_condition: Wall clock moves backwards and replay-denial entries subsequently expire.
guard_snippet: Enforce monotonic token deadlines or invalidate the sealing epoch on unsafe rollback; test beyond deny-list expiry.
potential_consequence: A replay-revoked token becomes usable again.

location: architecture.md ADR-008 Replay; ADR-009 Capacity model
trigger_condition: A code is replayed when the separate bounded deny-list is full.
guard_snippet: Reserve revocation capacity per code or record revocation in its reserved tombstone; preserve unexpired revocations.
potential_consequence: Issued tokens remain usable because family revocation cannot be recorded.

location: architecture.md ADR-009 Notification abuse; epics.md Story 2.5
trigger_condition: New identifiers arrive after the bounded target-bucket map fills.
guard_snippet: Refuse new entries without upstream pushes, preserve active buckets and define idle expiry.
potential_consequence: Eviction resets abuse limits or undefined admission blocks legitimate login.

location: architecture.md ADR-008 Client authentication; epics.md Story 2.4
trigger_condition: Two requests concurrently present the same otherwise valid private_key_jwt assertion.
guard_snippet: Atomically insert-if-absent jti and enforce the per-client cap under the same lock; test concurrency.
potential_consequence: Both requests can pass a non-atomic replay check.

location: architecture.md Flow state machine; ADR-010 Web2App return
trigger_condition: The callback precedes the poll response containing signature.userChallenge.
guard_snippet: Validate available bindings immediately; retain the bounded verifier and compare when the signed poll result arrives.
potential_consequence: The callback-first path cannot perform its required verifier comparison.

location: architecture.md ADR-010 Flow-scoped endpoints and Web2App return
trigger_condition: Cookie rotation overlaps an original-tab request carrying the retired binding token.
guard_snippet: Reject retired bindings without state changes and render the continue-in-other-tab notice; test overlapping requests.
potential_consequence: An in-flight request can disrupt completion or show the wrong recovery page.
